name: joshspeagle-site
description: Build and maintenance entry points for joshspeagle.com. `npm run build` compiles tokens, fonts, HTML, sitemap, and RSS feed; `npm run check` verifies HTML, links, tokens, and BibTeX consistency; `npm run propose` scans for candidate content updates.

scripts.build: python scripts/build_tokens.py && python scripts/setup_fonts.py && python scripts/build_html.py
